full_name: Uri McMillan | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Humanities Walter Jackson Bate Fellow University of California, Los Angeles
bio: Uri McMillan is a performance historian at UCLA, where he is an associate professor in the Departments of African American Studies, of English, and of Gender Studies. His research—a synthesis of art history and visual culture, feminist theory, performance studies, and Black diaspora studies—is primarily centered on African diasporic artistic production, with a particular focus on aesthetic and performance cultures.
